evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/t/c<T> extends rs/t/a, owns an int-keyed T cache plus the raw integer-to-map config corpus, reloads YAML/MessagePack data through the parent, and materializes each entry through abstract T a(int, Map<String,Object>).

The already reviewed R80 SequenceDefinitionConfigLoader, NpcDefinitionConfigLoader, SpotAnimationDefinitionConfigLoader, ItemDefinitionConfigLoader and ObjectDefinitionConfigLoader all extend this exact generic class.
The class exposes cached lookup by integer ID, existence testing, the underlying typed cache, and shared conversion helpers for byte, int-array, nested int-array and String-array config values.

proposals.note: DefinitionConfigLoader is a conservative semantic recovery name for the exact generic superclass used by the reviewed definition config loaders; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier. Confidence 0.997.
